title: Lightweight Recycled Carbon Fiber Carriage Design
summary: A five-person course team concept exploring recycled carbon-fiber composites for selected non-critical high-speed rail carbody components. The team report records my role as "Proposed Design"; the project does not establish train-level energy savings.

facts.publicText: Team report records my role as "Proposed Design"
Team concept focused on selected non-critical carbody components, layered composites, and interfaces with the existing metal frame or chassis
